- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in early periods of the 30-day forecast horizon.
- Forecasts tend to peak too early and then decline too quickly, missing sustained upward trends.
- After sharp spikes in true values (e.g., 38.18, 36.84), model underreacts or fails to capture the magnitude.
- Model shows strong mean reversion bias — overcorrects after minor price drops, leading to premature flattening.
- Forecasts lag behind true price movements by 2–5 days, particularly in upward trends.
- Model underestimates volatility in late periods, especially when true prices show sudden drops or spikes.
- Overshoots after initial spikes (e.g., 35.63 → 36.62) and fails to adjust downward in subsequent days.
- Model tends to ignore long-term trend persistence — overfits short-term noise and underestimates structural shifts.
